result.title: Open-Form Geometric Style Transfer
result.summary: A geometric style learned from one family of shapes is typically applied to new shapes from the same family. We consider a more challenging setting: learning the geometric design language of a stylized Latin alphabet and applying it to new forms, from Greek glyphs to entirely different structures such as human poses. We introduce Open-Form Geometric Style Transfer, where the forms to which a learned geometric style can be applied are not restricted to the shape family in which that style was observed. This setting is deceptively challenging: the difficulty is not merely learning a style, but learning the style without learning the shape family in which it was observed. We represent target forms by structural sketches and disentangle structural adherence from style realization using a Geometry LoRA and a style-specific LoRA. Critically, open-form transfer requires the Geometry LoRA to be universal. To achieve this, we devise a geometry-enrichment strategy that constructs a large and purposefully diverse collection of synthetic structural sketches spanning a broad range of unfamiliar geometries. Our experiments and ablations demonstrate the importance of both disentanglement and this universal geometry prior, enabling geometric styles learned from glyphs, pictograms, and other shape families to be transferred to substantially different, unseen forms.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Open-Form Geometric Style Transfer 设定：把从某类形状学到的几何风格迁移到结构完全不同（如希腊字母、人体姿态）的目标形式上，方法用结构化草图表示目标形状，并以 Geometry LoRA 与风格 LoRA 解耦结构遵循与风格实现，同时用大规模合成草图构造通用几何先验。
AI.relevance_reason: 以双 LoRA 解耦「结构」与「风格」、并用多样性合成数据塑造通用几何先验的做法，可能与 LVR 中如何在内部状态保留几何/视觉细节而剥离任务无关因素的问题相关，可供核查其解耦与数据构造思路能否迁移到 VLM 推理状态。
